name: Hikari Tropical Algae Wafers
description: Dense sinking discs for bottom-dwelling herbivores (plecos, otos, shrimp). Manufacturer guaranteed-analysis crude protein minimum is 33%. wasteFactor (0.3) is MODELLED — a wafer stays put and is clean when grazed promptly, but a heavy single-source nutrient load if left, so slightly above the pellet band.
notes: Substrate grazers. Remove the uneaten remnant after a few hours — a half-eaten wafer is a localized ammonia + detritus source.
